author: Bay State News
title: Northampton Arts Council seeks artist for First Night Northampton 2027 design
text:
The Northampton Arts Council announced on April 15 that it is seeking an original artwork to serve as the signature visual identity for First Night Northampton 2027. The annual New Year’s Eve festival, now approaching its 42nd year, will feature the selected design on admission buttons, posters, digital media, and event programs.
The call for artists is significant as the chosen artwork will represent one of the city’s most prominent cultural celebrations. The selected artist will receive a $500 honorarium upon delivery of final design assets.
Brian Foote, Director of Arts and Culture, said: “The visual identity of First Night is a storied tradition in Northampton. We are looking for a design that is vibrant, iconic, and scalable—something that captures the spirit of the arts in our community whether it is viewed on a two-inch button or an 11×17-inch poster.”
Artists interested in applying must submit their designs by May 15 through an online application form. The selection will be made by May 22. Final artwork must be delivered as a high-resolution digital vector image without text; event titles and dates will be added later by organizers. The honorarium payment will be issued after all assets are received by July 1.
Applicants are encouraged to review past festival designs available in an online archive to understand how previous artists have balanced creativity with functional needs for promotional materials. By submitting their work, artists grant rights to use their design across all festival-related media and merchandise.
For more information or questions about the application process, individuals can contact the Northampton Arts Council via email at arts@northamptonma.gov or call 413-587-1069.
